chapter: New York arrival, Billy Hicks and the Black Cat
title: Bands opposite Chick Webb at the Savoy and Jesse Owens's band
summary: Hall lists bands that played opposite his group at the Savoy and tells how a band was promoted for Jesse Owens and fell apart.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: But to go back to the Savoy, what other bands did you play opposite besides Chick Webb?
Whoever came in there. Tommy Dorsey, Bunny Berigan, Erskine Hawkins, Teddy Hill, even -- what's the champion runner from Munich, Jesse Owens had a band.
He had a band and this is a funny thing. He had a band -- They were trying to promote him with a band.
Right after the Olympics, I guess.
Well, now, it wasn't right after.

Yeah, and they tried to promote him as a bandleader and he knows nothing about the business, nor his promoters and he hired New York musicians and you have rehearsal and you can get a draw. A cat would get a draw today and don't show tomorrow, or ever.
So how did he finally put a band in there.
Was it a regular big band.
Yeah, it was a big band. It had to be a big band, because he's replacing Chick Webb.
Do you remember who played in that band.
